annotations.text: Crew view: what a share link opens. Read-only — no editing, no race switcher. Event is the headline; regatta beneath; Map link on the venue line.
Clock block: NEXT on top (always), HANDS ON gets the big digits until it passes, RACE START alongside. A 'running late' value shifts every time and shows an orange badge.

Race intel is AI-filled from the Regatta Central link alone: event, regatta, venue/map, preceding event, lane (hidden for head races), competitors with last year's results. Every card carries its source and fetch time. Competitor numbers here are sample values from your sheet.
